categories.main_business_segments: Juneway Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic components industry, focusing on the design, research, manufacturing, and sales of current sensing precision resistors and fuses. Their products serve various sectors including consumer electronics, white goods, industrial power supplies, industrial security, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, battery formation and grading, and new energy vehicles. The company also produces composite alloy wires, overvoltage protection components, electrostatic protection components, high-frequency components, capacitors, filters, compensators, temperature sensors, precision resistors, high-density interconnect multilayer boards, rigid printed circuit boards, automated precision equipment, functional new materials, and metal and ceramic electroplating treatments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced manufacturing processes covering the entire production chain of current sensing precision resistors, including board forming, circuit forming, electron beam welding, cutting, forming, injection molding, laser, electroplating, and packaging. They have mastered core technologies such as lamination bonding, thin film sputtering, and photolithography, and have developed low-resistance alloy materials. The company emphasizes automation and process optimization to improve product quality and production efficiency. Their fuse products utilize metal melting principles with materials like lead-tin alloy, zinc, copper, and silver, offering high breaking capacity and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Juneway serves leading global brands in consumer electronics, home appliances, industrial control, 5G communications, new energy, and automotive electronics. Key customers include A company, Samsung, New Energy, Xiaomi, Gree, Midea, Daikin, Delta, Sunwoda, Hikvision, Dahua, Source Technology, Qualcomm, Nvidia, BYD, and others. Their products are widely used in smartphones, laptops, smart wearables, drones, portable energy storage, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, industrial power supplies, industrial security, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, battery formation and grading, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangmen, Suzhou, and Zhuhai. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in the United States, Japan, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, serving customers across North America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and other key markets. The company is expanding its global footprint with a focus on Japan, South Korea, India, Europe, and North America, and has obtained multiple international certifications to support global market access.
categories.supply_chain_position: Juneway operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronic components supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision resistors and fuses. It controls the full production process for its core products, including raw material selection and processing, enabling comprehensive cost control and quality assurance. The company also procures some related products externally to complement its offerings and optimize resource allocation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in process optimization, equipment upgrades, and material innovation to enhance product performance and cost competitiveness. It focuses on miniaturization, high precision, low resistance, and high power capacity of current sensing resistors and fuse products. Strategic R&D projects include developing small-sized SMD fuses, high-safety automotive fuses, high breaking capacity fuses for energy storage, and embedded micro SMD resistors. The company aims to expand into new markets such as automotive electronics, new energy storage, AI servers, and to develop integrated current sensing solutions including TMR current sensor modules.
categories.revenue_model: Juneway generates revenue primarily through the sale of electronic components, including current sensing precision resistors and fuses. The company uses a direct sales model as the main channel, supplemented by distribution. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at delivery or customer acceptance. The company also receives government subsidies related to its operations, which are recognized as other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Juneway is a global leader in the current sensing precision resistor segment, competing with international well-known companies such as Yageo, QianKun, Littelfuse, Eaton, Schurter, and SOC. The company holds a strong market position with advanced manufacturing capabilities and a broad customer base including top-tier global brands. It differentiates itself through comprehensive in-house production processes, high product precision, and strong R&D capabilities, enabling it to maintain a competitive edge in high-end markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Juneway achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 659.5 million, representing a 16.94% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 105.55 million, up 17.39%. The company’s assets totaled about RMB 1.25 billion, with net assets of RMB 963 million, reflecting steady growth. The company’s R&D expenses accounted for about 4.14% of revenue, indicating sustained investment in innovation. Cash flow from operating activities increased by 15.49% to RMB 159.8 million, demonstrating healthy operational cash generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Juneway emphasizes high precision, low resistance, miniaturization, and high power capacity in its current sensing precision resistors, with product sizes as small as 01005 (0.4mm x 0.2mm), thickness down to 0.3mm, resistance as low as 25 micro-ohms, and accuracy up to 0.1%. Its fuses offer high breaking capacity, fast response, and high reliability, suitable for demanding applications including automotive and energy storage. The company’s full-process manufacturing control ensures consistent quality and cost advantages. It provides integrated current sensing and circuit protection solutions tailored to customer needs, supported by extensive technical services and global certifications, creating strong customer loyalty and competitive barriers.
